site_schema.summary: The site-wide schema presents GoGloby as an Applied AI development partner and promotes discontinued development services. It also contains unsupported performance, timing, security and founder claims.

llm_problems.title: Discontinued AI development positioning
llm_problems.rule: decisions.md: Company description; Fact Sheet: Identity and Services; Glossary §7
llm_problems.issue: The schema positions GoGloby as an Applied AI engineering and development partner rather than a staffing and recruiting agency.
llm_problems.fix: Replace the discontinued positioning and development offers with the approved company description and current services.
llm_problems.subject: GoGloby positioning and offers
llm_problems.page_value: Applied AI engineering and development services
llm_problems.source_value: Staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers

locations.quote: Applied AI Engineering Partner

llm_problems.title: EU time zones presented as service area
llm_problems.issue: The description presents the US and EU time zones as the service area, while current services cover US onsite or hybrid recruiting and Latin American staffing on US hours.
llm_problems.fix: Correct the service locations and working hours to match the current service models.
llm_problems.subject: Service locations
llm_problems.source_value: US onsite or hybrid; Latin America remote on US hours

locations.quote: within the US & EU time zones.

llm_problems.fix: Remove the superlative or obtain evidence supporting it.

locations.quote: the world's most thoroughly vetted talent

llm_problems.title: Unverified four-week deployment promise
